versions.changelog:
Initial release of Accounts Payable Automation Framework.

- Provides end-to-end AP management framework, including automated invoice processing, payment optimization, approval routing, and vendor management.
- Includes a robust month-end close checklist and key performance metrics for benchmarking.
- Features fraud prevention best practices and roles segregation recommendations.
- Offers industry-tailored context packs and workflow tools to support compliance and AP process automation.
